hostname rt-s01
!
interface Loopback0
 description sample id
 ip address 192.0.2.201 255.255.255.255
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan
 ip address 203.0.113.49 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf hello-interval 5
 ip ospf dead-interval 20
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 vrrp 1 ip 198.51.100.1
 vrrp 1 priority 110
!
ip sla 1
 icmp-echo 203.0.113.50 source-interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 frequency 5
ip sla schedule 1 life forever start-time now
track 1 ip sla 1 reachability
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 192.0.2.201
 area 1 stub
 redistribute static subnets
 passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 network 192.0.2.201 0.0.0.0 area 0
 network 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 area 1
 network 203.0.113.48 0.0.0.3 area 0
!
router bgp 64500
 bgp router-id 192.0.2.201
 neighbor 203.0.113.50 remote-as 64501
 neighbor 203.0.113.50 description sample-upstream
 neighbor 203.0.113.50 password dummy-bgp-key-s
 neighbor 203.0.113.50 prefix-list pl-s-in in
 network 198.51.100.0 mask 255.255.255.0
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.50 track 1
!
ip access-list extended acl-s-nat
 permit ip 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255 any
!
ip prefix-list pl-s-in seq 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0
!
ip nat inside source list acl-s-nat interface GigabitEthernet0/0 overload
!
end
